title: KiteFin private deploy implementation scratchpad
content:
Context: KiteFin (payment rails startup) - wants Private deployment into their GCP project behind VPC, HSM for keys, strict egress controls. Small POC (Q2) -> then Dedicated reserved nodes in customer-managed VPC. This doc = my day-to-day scratchpad for config notes, quick commands, and action items.

Top-level objectives (POC scope):
- Stand up Redwood Private Control Plane in KiteFin dev VPC (isolated project).
- Deploy inference worker pool (4 GPUs) using customer GKE Autopilot initially; evaluate switching to Anthos edge later.
- Integrate with KiteFin KMS/HSM (PKCS#11) for model secrets.
- Validate latency and p50/p95 for common flows; create perf baseline.

Quick open questions / unknowns (to surface in sync):
- KiteFin compliance: do we need full FIPS mode on all nodes or only KMS module? (Lina to confirm with security)
- Are any egress IP allowlists required for partner APIs (Plaid, bank partners)? Customer will provide list but may change.
- Expected concurrency pattern: spikey business hours 9-11am PT -> need autoscale policy boundaries. Ask: target concurrency per GPU?

Notes / config snippets (temporary):
- Model selection: prefer open 13B for baseline; customer asked to compare latencies for 13B vs 20B quantized.
- Runtime config: continuous batching on, kv-cache enabled; target latency SLO = 120ms p50 for short prompts (<128 tokens).

Helm values (working draft):
redwood:
  private:
    enabled: true
    controlPlane:
      replicaCount: 2
      externalHostname: control.kitefin.redwood.local
    workers:
      gpuPool:
        count: 4
        instanceType: a2-highgpu-1g # placeholder, validate with infra
        model: open-13b-4bit
    kms:
      provider: pkcs11
      endpoint: /usr/local/lib/softHSM2.so # customer will provide HSM path
    networking:
      vpcCidr: 10.24.0.0/16
      privateSubnets: [10.24.1.0/24,10.24.2.0/24]

Kubernetes / infra quick commands I used: (keep for repro)
- kubectl -n redwood get pods --watch
- helm upgrade --install redwood-private ./charts/redwood -f kitefin-values.yaml --namespace redwood --create-namespace
- gcloud compute firewall-rules create allow-redwood-egress --direction=EGRESS --priority=1000 --network=kitefin-vpc --destination-ranges=0.0.0.0/0 --action=deny # temp block; then add allowlists

Firewall / network checklist: (note: customer uses VPC-native firewall, need low-touch)
- [ ] Request static egress IPs from KiteFin infra team (for partner allowlists) - due 2026-03-17 (Ethan)
- [ ] Confirm subnets are private and NAT is configured for outbound updates (Lina)
- [ ] Add egress allowlist for monitoring endpoints (Datadog ingest, S3 model fetch)

Secrets / keys:
- HSM integration: need PKCS#11 connector + tests. Local test using SoftHSM2 succeeded; production requires vendor HSM slot IDs.
- Workaround: use envelope encryption with customer's KMS for per-model keys. Document flow: model artifact encrypted at rest, control plane requests decrypt token via HSM.

Performance notes from initial run (dev cluster):
- 13B quantized (4-bit) baseline: p50 210ms, p95 480ms for prompt len 64. Throughput per GPU ~18 rps.
- 20B quantized: p50 320ms, p95 720ms. Memory pressure higher; KV cache grows quickly for beam workloads.
- Observed spikes correlated with GC events in sidecar (observability agent) - try lowering sample rate.

Action items (owner / ETA):
- [ ] Lina: Confirm FIPS/HSM requirements and provide HSM vendor contact - 2026-03-16
- [ ] Ethan: Provide static egress IPs + partner allowlist entries - 2026-03-17
- [ ] Ravi (me): Prepare perf comparison notebook for 13B vs 20B quantized and push to PR - 2026-03-14
- [ ] Ops: Run overnight soak test on 4-GPU pool with 8k p90 synthetic load - tentative 2026-03-19

Notes to self (quick):
- If helm install fails on CRDs, run: kubectl apply -f crds.yaml --validate=false
- When asking infra for IAM, request workload identity binding for control-plane SA instead of K8s secrets
- Avoid reverting to non-quantized models for cost reasons; only use float16 for final quality checks

Meeting notes snippet (2026-03-12 sync with KiteFin infra):
- Customer will provision dedicated GCP project and VPC; networking owner = serena@kitefin.com
- HSM procurement in progress (vendor: Thales?), ETA 6-8 weeks. For POC, use SoftHSM2 with strict audit logs.
- Data residency: logs must not leave region us-west1. Need to ensure observability agents respect region.

Follow-ups for next sync:
- Demo plan: short-scripted flows showing fallback to hosted model when worker pool saturated. (demo script draft attached to PR)
- Decide canary rollout strategy: 10% traffic -> 50% -> 100% over 24h with rollback on quality regression. Map this to Redwood console rollout settings.

Random TODOs (personal):
- push kitefin-values.yaml to repo and tag with KF-POC branch
- write short runbook for on-call to recycle worker pool safely (kubectl scale + wait for drain)

End of scratchpad entry. Keep this as working doc — will prune and move to Confluence once stable notes collected.
